_description: Sep-Nov 2024 focused window to evaluate oscillation guard vs no-guard. Starts at end-of-August 2024 equity snapshot (~$75k) from the 2-year H2 baseline run, giving apples-to-apples comparison. Run once with oscillation_guard=false (baseline) and once with oscillation_guard=true.
notes: Sep 3 - Nov 29, 2024. Initial equity = $75,087 (end-of-Aug snapshot from 2-year H2 baseline).
Sep-Oct: choppy regime, multiple FULL->REDUCED->FULL oscillations.
Nov 5: US election day. Nov 6-11: post-election rally (+20% in ~1 week).
Compare osc_guard_OFF vs osc_guard_ON to measure guard cost/benefit on this window.
oscillation_guard defaults false - add --regime.oscillation_guard true for guard-on run.
